def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    from math import gcd

    prefix = [0]
    for value in a:
        prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)

    hull = []
    head = 0
    best_p, best_q = 0, 1

    for end in range(k, len(prefix)):
        new = end - k

        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            x, y = hull[-2], hull[-1]
            if (prefix[y] - prefix[x]) * (new - y) < (
                prefix[new] - prefix[y]
            ) * (y - x):
                break
            hull.pop()
        hull.append(new)

        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            x, y = hull[head], hull[head + 1]
            if (prefix[end] - prefix[x]) * (end - y) > (
                prefix[end] - prefix[y]
            ) * (end - x):
                break
            head += 1

        start = hull[head]
        p = prefix[end] - prefix[start]
        q = end - start
        if p * best_q > best_p * q:
            best_p, best_q = p, q

    divisor = gcd(best_p, best_q)
    return [best_p // divisor, best_q // divisor]
